IDENT.title: Design, Application, and Evaluation of a Multiagent System in the Logistics Domain
IDENT.venue: IEEE Transactions on Automation Science and Engineering

A_DEFINITION__agent_definition_verbatim.value: No formal definition; agents described as software agents controlling system parts that communicate and collaborate to fulfill an automation task jointly.
A_DEFINITION__agent_definition_verbatim.evidence_quote: software agents control parts of a system, such as the aMFMs, which communicate and collaborate to fulfill a given automation task jointly [6].

A_DEFINITION__agent_term_used.evidence_quote: each controlled by a dedicated module agent

A_DEFINITION__agent_entity_types.evidence_quote: Combined with the coordinator agent, it enables performing a global planning and coordination assignment

B_ARCHITECTURE__has_knowledge_base.evidence_quote: the knowledge base of aMFM agents needs to be uniform, and thus defined based on a metamodel (R1).

B_ARCHITECTURE__kb_representation.evidence_quote: Based on the SAIL-compliant metamodel AutoMFM [4], heterogeneous aMFMs can be modeled, and thus the respective aMFM agents’ knowledge base is formed

B_ARCHITECTURE__decision_scalability_dis.evidence_quote: a central, redundantly designed instance represents a limitation in scalability if, for example, the maximum communication or computing load is reached

B_ARCHITECTURE__has_communication_manage.evidence_quote: The developed communication ontology includes them both and defines the contents of the messages exchanged.

B_ARCHITECTURE__implementation_platform.evidence_quote: the agent-based control approach is implemented on Beckhoff PLCs

C_MEMORY__memory_historical.evidence_quote: information regarding the controlled aMFM itself, such as the geometry or abilities offered by the aMFM (which is referred to as static information)

C_MEMORY__memory_historical_description.value: Static aMFM description (geometry, abilities) plus dynamic info like current neighbors computed at runtime.
C_MEMORY__memory_historical_description.evidence_quote: knowledge such as current, connected neighbors of the aMFM (which represents dynamic information calculated during runtime

C_MEMORY__memory_realtime.evidence_quote: information from the aMFM’s sensors and information exchanged with other aMFMs

C_MEMORY__memory_scope.evidence_quote: has only a limited view over the aMFS consisting of a priori implemented knowledge

C_MEMORY__memory_update_mechanism.evidence_quote: is calculated during runtime of the aMFM and provided to the module agent, e.g., by the coordinator.

C_MEMORY__memory_requirements_stated.evidence_quote: a module agent’s knowledge base needs to contain information on the aMFM’s capabilities

D_COMMUNICATION__comm_protocol.evidence_quote: With the ADS protocol, the Beckhoff programming environment provides a simple way of establishing communication between two PLCs via TCP.

D_COMMUNICATION__negotiation_mechanism.evidence_quote: For each material flow relation, the ssR concept negotiates a route in the aMFS

D_COMMUNICATION__comm_topology.evidence_quote: the aMFS control represents a hybrid architecture with both, distributed and decentralized agents forming the MAS and a centralized coordinator

D_COMMUNICATION__comm_cost_analyzed.evidence_quote: Highly flexible routing causes a high communication load with regard to traffic.

D_COMMUNICATION__handles_comm_failure.evidence_quote: technical restrictions can lead to delays in message transmission, which in the worst case even leads to the formation of a deadlock

E_LEARNING__learning_present.evidence_quote: In future research, route optimization with Neural Networks

G_VALIDATION_METRICS__validation_level.evidence_quote: we implemented the agent-based concept on a lab-sized demonstrator

G_VALIDATION_METRICS__metrics_reported.evidence_quote: the throughput increased by about 53% compared to a control, which did not apply a strategy

G_VALIDATION_METRICS__baseline_compared_.evidence_quote: Online optimization increased throughput compared to highly dynamic routing

G_VALIDATION_METRICS__disruption_types_h.evidence_quote: Addition of an aMFM during runtime

G_VALIDATION_METRICS__system_scale.evidence_quote: we divided the demonstrator’s logistics part into four aMFMs, each controlled by a Beckhoff PLC

G_VALIDATION_METRICS__application_domain.evidence_quote: a holistic, agentbased control concept for aMFSs

H_STANDARDS__standards_referenced.evidence_quote: Each aMFM, performing either a transportation or a manipulation ability, is controlled by a dedicated PLC, programmed in compliance to the IEC 61131-3.

H_STANDARDS__ontology_used.value: AutoMFM / IntraMAS metamodels; custom communication ontology
H_STANDARDS__ontology_used.evidence_quote: the simplified metamodel IntraMAS, which is similar to AutoMFM

H_STANDARDS__interoperability_claimed.evidence_quote: Due to the uniform, metamodel-based knowledge base of the aMFM agents, heterogeneous aMFMs can collaborate

I_DELTA_VS_REFERENCE__features_common_wi.evidence_quote: the pure hardware control of the aMFM’s automation hardware, and an agent-part

I_DELTA_VS_REFERENCE__features_divergent.value: No product (TU) agent; resource-only agents with central coordinator, semi-static routing, operator HMI visualization; contrasts itself with Kovalenko's product agent work which does not consider reconfiguration.
I_DELTA_VS_REFERENCE__features_divergent.evidence_quote: the approach focuses on the communication and collaboration of different agent types and does not consider reconfiguration of the controlled system.

I_DELTA_VS_REFERENCE__essential_componen.value: Claims uniform metamodel-based knowledge base needed, though later concedes metamodel not necessarily required.
I_DELTA_VS_REFERENCE__essential_componen.evidence_quote: a metamodel is not necessarily required if, instead, detailed programming guidelines or templates are used.

I_DELTA_VS_REFERENCE__cites_reference_fr.evidence_quote: Kovalenko et al. present a methodology to enable flexible manufacturing systems based on two different kinds of agents [21].

I_DELTA_VS_REFERENCE__static_vs_dynamic_.evidence_quote: The concept allows reconfiguring an aMFS consisting of heterogeneous, stationary aMFMs, during runtime.
